text: An Nulaaɗo, rewɓe goo dagitantaako ma resugol, ɓaawo suddiiɓe maa ɓen, dagantaako ma kadi seerugol ɓe, maa seerugol woɗɓe e maɓɓe fii no resi woɗɓe goo, hay si ŋari ɓen ɓe faala-ɗaa resude haawnii ma. Ko woni tun, hino dagano maa dakmitorgol horɓe ɓe jeyru-ɗaa ñaamo maa ɓen, ko aldaa e happugol adadu limoore. Alla laatike annduɗo kala huunde, tommbiiɗo. Ndee ñaawoore hino tinndina ɓure neeniraaɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen, tawde seerugol ɓe haɗaa ma.
